_comment: GROUND TRUTH for the did_v1 side of the V_eta migration: the NDI document templates, read from origin/main. THIS FILE IS AUTHORITATIVE -- schemas/V_alpha and the V_delta conversion markdown are history, not evidence. Where a template and its WRITER disagree, the writer wins (see writer_divergence): the data follows the writer. Regenerate with tools/ndi_ground_truth.py. See V_eta_ground_truth_plan.md.

writer_divergence.writer_emits: ontologyNodes (plural) -- a comma-joined, sorted list of ONE OR MORE CURIEs, each normalised via ndi.ontology.lookup
writer_divergence.note: The writer's own lookup query also uses the plural (ndi.query('ontologyImage.ontologyNodes', ...)), so the plural is authoritative and the template is stale. Multi-CURIE means a single ontology_term field cannot hold it.

writer_divergence.writer_emits: a struct {S, KXV, KYV, ORDER} of parallel per-frame arrays
writer_divergence.note: The V_delta conversion doc recorded it as matrix<double>, matching the template rather than the data.
NOT a template/writer disagreement -- recorded because the MIGRATOR (+did2/+convert/+migrators/ngrid.m) deletes it with rmfield, so real coordinate data is dropped today. Phase 3.
